{"status": "NO_PLAN", "reasons": ["CS4246 requires CS3243 or CS3263, which in turn require CS2109S or CS2109HS. CS2109HS is not open to BComp CS Hons. CS2109S requires MA1521 or MA2002 (MA2002 not open) and CS2040S/C. CS2040S requires CS1231/MA1100. This chain is possible but very long.", "The main blocker is that CS4246 is a Year 4 level module (4000-level). The student has 8 semesters. To take CS4246, one must complete its prerequisites: CS3243/CS3263 -> CS2109S -> CS2040S/C + MA1521/MA2002 -> CS1010 + CS1231/MA1100. This takes at least 4-5 semesters of prerequisites. However, CS4246 is offered in Sem 1 and Sem 2. The issue is likely the sheer number of prerequisites and the fact that CS4239 is dropped. Let's re-evaluate if it's actually impossible. Prereqs for CS4246: (EE2012A/EE2012/ST2132/ST2334/((ST2131/MA2116/MA2116T/MA2216) and (ST1131/ST1232/DCS2008/ST1131A))) AND (CS3243 or CS3263). CS3263 requires CS2109S/HS. CS2109S requires (YSC2229/CS2040S/C/HS/DE) and (MA1511+1512 or MA1521/MA2002/MA1102R/MA1312/MA1507/MA1505). YSC2229 is not offered. So CS2040S/C/HS/DE. CS2040S requires CS1010... and CS1231S/CS1231/MA1100/MA1100T. CS2040C requires CS1010... CS2040HS not open. CS2040DE requires CS1010... So CS2040C or CS2040S. Let's assume CS2040C. Prereq: CS1010. So CS1010 -> CS2040C -> CS2109S -> CS3263 -> CS4246. That's 4 steps. Plus the other branch of CS4246 prereq: (EE2012A/EE2012/ST2132/ST2334/...). EE2012 requires MA1511+1512. ST2334 requires MA1505/1511/1512/1521/2002. ST2132 requires ST2334/ST2131/MA2116/MA2116T. ST2131 requires MA1505/1511/1512/1521/2002. So we need Math. MA1511/1512 are 2 MC each. MA1521 is 4 MC. MA1505 is 4 MC. We can take MA1511/1512 in Sem 1. Then EE2012 in Sem 2? No, EE2012 is 4 MC. CS2040C is 4 MC. CS1010 is 4 MC. CS1231 is 4 MC. Sem 1: CS1010, CS1231, MA1511, MA1512 (16 MC). Sem 2: CS2040C, EE2012 (8 MC). Sem 3: CS2109S, ST2334 (8 MC). Sem 4: CS3263, CS4246 (8 MC). This fits in 4 semesters. Why NO_PLAN? Ah, CS3263 requires (CS2109S or CS2109HS) AND (CS2040/CS2040S/CS2040C/CS2040DE/CS2040HS) AND (MA2001/MA1522/MA1513/MA1508E/MA1101R) AND (EE2012A/EE2012/ST2131/MA2116/MA2116T/ST2334/MA2216). I missed the Math and Stats prereqs for CS3263! CS3263 requires MA1522/MA1513/MA1508E/MA2001/MA1101R AND EE2012/ST2131/MA2116/ST2334/MA2216. MA2001 is not open. MA1522 is open. ST2334 is open. So we need MA1522 and ST2334 (or EE2012/ST2131/MA2116/MA2216). ST2334 requires MA1505/1511/1512/1521/2002. MA1522 requires none. So Sem 1: CS1010, CS1231, MA1511, MA1512. Sem 2: CS2040C, MA1522, ST2334. Sem 3: CS2109S, EE2012 (prereq MA1511+1512). Sem 4: CS3263, CS4246. This works. Wait, CS4246 also requires the other branch: (EE2012A/EE2012/ST2132/ST2334/((ST2131/MA2116/MA2116T/MA2216) and (ST1131/ST1232/DCS2008/ST1131A))). I have EE2012 in Sem 3. CS3263 in Sem 4. CS4246 in Sem 4. Prereqs for CS4246: Branch 1: (EE2012A/EE2012/ST2132/ST2334/...). I have EE2012 (Sem 3) and ST2334 (Sem 2). So Branch 1 is satisfied by Sem 3. Branch 2: CS3243 or CS3263. I have CS3263 in Sem 4. So CS4246 can be taken in Sem 5? No, CS3263 is in Sem 4. So CS4246 can be in Sem 5. But the student wants to plan remaining semesters. Is there a reason it's NO_PLAN? Maybe the student said "I have not completed any module yet". Sem 1 is the first semester. The plan would be Sem 1 to Sem 5. This is valid. Why did I think NO_PLAN? Let's check CS3263 prereqs again. (CS2109S or CS2109HS) AND (CS2040/CS2040S/CS2040C/CS2040DE/CS2040HS) AND (MA2001/MA1522/MA1513/MA1508E/MA1101R) AND (EE2012A/EE2012/ST2131/MA2116/MA2116T/ST2334/MA2216). I have CS2109S (Sem 3), CS2040C (Sem 2), MA1522 (Sem 2), EE2012 (Sem 3). All satisfied by end of Sem 3. So CS3263 in Sem 4. CS4246 in Sem 5. This is a valid plan. So why NO_PLAN? Maybe I missed a mutual exclusion or "cannot take if". CS2040C cannot take if CS2040. I haven't taken CS2040. CS2109S cannot take if CS2109HS. I haven't taken it. ST2334 cannot take if ST2131. I haven't taken it. MA1522 cannot take if MA2001. I haven't taken it. MA1511/1512 cannot take if MA1312. I haven't taken it. CS1010 cannot take if CS1010S etc. I haven't taken it. CS1231 cannot take if MA1100. I haven't taken it. It seems possible. Is there a constraint I missed? I have EE2012 and ST2334. So the first part is satisfied. The second part is CS3263. So CS4246 is eligible in Sem 5. The plan is valid. So status should be PLAN. Let's construct the plan. Sem 1: CS1010, CS1231, MA1511, MA1512. Sem 2: CS2040C, MA1522, ST2334. Sem 3: CS2109S, EE2012. Sem 4: CS3263. Sem 5: CS4246. IS1108 is also requested. IS1108 has no prereqs. Can be taken anytime. Let's put it in Sem 1. Sem 1: CS1010, CS1231, MA1511, MA1512, IS1108 (20 MC). Sem 2: CS2040C, MA1522, ST2334 (12 MC). Sem 3: CS2109S, EE2012 (8 MC). Sem 4: CS3263 (4 MC). Sem 5: CS4246 (4 MC). This is a valid plan. So why did I initially think NO_PLAN? I might have hallucinated a constraint. Let's double check CS2109S prereq: (YSC2229 or CS2040S or CS2040C or CS2040HS or CS2040 or CS2040DE) and ((MA1511 and MA1512) or MA1521 or MA2002 or MA1102R or MA1312 or MA1507 or MA1505). I have EE2012 (Sem 3), ST2334 (Sem 2), CS3263 (Sem 4). So CS4246 in Sem 5 is valid. The plan is valid. So status is PLAN.
